# LeakSanitizer suppressions for php_excel CI.
#
# Format: "leak:<substring>", where the substring must appear in some frame
# of the leak's stack trace. Add narrow entries here rather than setting
# ASAN_OPTIONS detect_leaks=0 in .github/workflows/tests.yml; see
# ~/ai/wiki/debugging/asan-php-extension.md.
#
# To audit a new leak locally:
#   ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 LSAN_OPTIONS=fast_unwind_on_malloc=0 \
#     <asan-php> -d extension=php_excel.so -r '<repro>'

# libxl 5.2.0's xlTableRemoveFilter() leaks 72 bytes per call inside the SDK
# (operator new in libxl.so, not freed at xlBookRelease); a pure-C repro
# confirms it. ExcelTable::removeFilter() only calls the void libxl function
# and has nothing to release. libxl ships stripped, so the library name is the
# narrowest match. Applied only to the two PHPTs that call it; the main ASan
# suite runs unsuppressed. Reported to libxl support; remove once a fixed SDK
# ships.
leak:libxl.so
